stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
For a finite locally free morphism $Z\to U$ and an étale algebraic-space morphism $W\to Z$, the functor of sections $F(T)=\{\sigma:Z\times_UT\to W\times_UT\mid\sigma\text{ is a section over }Z\times_UT\}$ on $U$-schemes is an fppf sheaf. If $W\to Z$ is surjective, sections exist étale-locally on $U$.

Let $Z \to U$ be a finite morphism of schemes.
Let $W$ be an algebraic space and let $W \to Z$ be a
surjective \'etale morphism. Then there exists a surjective
\'etale morphism $U' \to U$ and a section
$$
\sigma : Z_{U'} \to W_{U'}
$$
of the morphism $W_{U'} \to Z_{U'}$.
hypotheses: For a finite locally free morphism $Z\to U$ and an étale algebraic-space morphism $W\to Z$, the functor of sections $F(T)=\{\sigma:Z\times_UT\to W\times_UT\mid\sigma\text{ is a section over }Z\times_UT\}$ on $U$-schemes is an fppf sheaf. If $W\to Z$ is surjective, sections exist étale-locally on $U$.
conclusions:
there exists a surjective
\'etale morphism $U' \to U$ and a section
$$
\sigma : Z_{U'} \to W_{U'}
$$
of the morphism $W_{U'} \to Z_{U'}$.

reason: Finite morphisms and surjective étale maps can be split over suitable étale neighbourhoods into finite local pieces; the residue-field argument yields local isomorphisms and hence a section.

Let $Z \to U$ be a finite locally free morphism of schemes.
Let $W$ be an algebraic space and let $W \to Z$ be an \'etale morphism.
Then the functor
$$
F : (\operatorname{Sch}/U)_{fppf}^{opp} \longrightarrow \textit{Sets},
$$
defined by the rule
$$
U' \longmapsto
F(U') =
\{\sigma : Z_{U'} \to W_{U'}\text{ section of }W_{U'} \to Z_{U'}\}
$$
is an algebraic space and the morphism $F \to U$ is \'etale.

\{\sigma : Z_{U'} \to W_{U'}\text{ section of }W_{U'} \to Z_{U'}\}
$$

reason: When W/Z is separated, the section functor embeds as an open part of the finite-part algebraic space; in general, a separated étale cover yields a surjective étale descent presentation.
